subject: Request: credits & trial extension after sustained 504s and elevated latencies
messages:
From: Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@orioncommerce.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Service disruption on 4/18 — request for credits and trial extension

Hi Jordan / Laura,

We're still feeling the fallout from the event on April 18 that started ~08:45 PDT and lasted intermittently through ~11:20 PDT. During that window our checkout microservice experienced a ~20% error rate (504s) and a substantial rise in tail latency. That caused roughly 12 production incidents for our customers and blocked several campaigns.

I've attached our trace and a usage snapshot that show the request bursts and the upstream timeouts. Can you please confirm:

- Whether this was platform-side throttling or an underlying node/rebalance issue
- Proposed remediation and timeline for preventing recurrence
- What kind of customer goodwill you can provide (token credits, trial extension, any checklist we should share internally)

We're a mid-size customer with an active POC that renews in Q3 (HubSpot: ORC-7192). Our finance team will expect some form of compensatory credit and a 30–60 day trial extension to make up for lost developer time.

Appreciate a prompt reply — happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Thanks,
Ellen Shaw
Head of Platform Reliability
Orion Commerce
(attachment: incident_trace_20270418.log)
(attachment: usage_snapshot_2027-04-18.csv)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Shaw <ellen.shaw@orioncommerce.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Service disruption on 4/18 — request for credits and trial extension

Laura / Ben / Monica — looping you in, Ellen sent the traces above. TL;DR: sustained 504s + elevated p95/p99 for ~2.5 hours hitting Orion's checkout path. Ellen asked for credits + 30–60 day extension.

Quick proposal from my side (pending approvals):
- One-time 150,000 token credit applied to account ORC-7192
- 30-day trial extension on their current dev bundle (to compensate for lost testing window)
- Internal follow-up: Engineering to confirm root cause & mitigation plan by EOD 4/19

Reasoning: the incident appears to be a capacity/rebalancer delay combined with prefix cache misses; we want to be generous but also keep cadence for mid-market credits. If finance/sign-off wants to escalate, we can go to 200K tokens.

Can you each confirm approval (Ben for commercial, Laura for exceptions, Monica for finance sign-off) so I can send the formal offer to Ellen?

I attached a quick analysis link and the JIRA ref.

-Jordan
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
(Internal: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/ORC-7192/incident-analysis)

Jordan — approved with a small adjustment. Finance signed off on the credit but would prefer to apply 175,000 tokens (midpoint) plus a 45-day extension rather than 30. That gives Orion more runway without setting too high a precedent.

Action items I will take:
- I will prepare the formal goodwill offer and send to Ellen today (include the token credit + 45-day extension)
- Request legal to include a short clause clarifying this is a one-time courtesy and not a SLA amendment
- Ask billing to flag ORC-7192 so credits are applied once Ellen confirms PO/acceptance

If there are objections to the amount, call me — otherwise I'll proceed.

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Hi Ellen — thanks again for the detailed traces. We're sorry for the impact this caused.

We'd like to offer the following as a one-time courtesy to make up for the disruption:

- 175,000 token credit applied to account ORC-7192 (usable across hosted API calls)
- 45-day extension on your current dev/trial window
- Engineering will deliver a written postmortem and a mitigation plan (expected EOD 4/20)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you accept this package and whether your team needs a PO or DocuSign to finalize.
2) Once you confirm, Billing will apply the credit and we'll update your HubSpot record.

If you want a slightly larger commercial package, Ben is happy to discuss separately.

Best,
